title: Sales Administrator
description:
We are currently recruiting for a Sales Administrator to join a busy and successful motor trade business. This is an exciting opportunity for an organised and proactive individual who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment and providing excellent administrative support to a busy sales team.

As a Sales Administrator, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth processing of vehicle sales from order through to delivery. Working closely with the sales team and management, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate records and delivering a high level of customer service.

Key Responsibilities of the Sales Administrator role:
- Processing vehicle sales documentation accurately and efficiently.
- Preparing and maintaining vehicle stock records.
- Liaising with customers, finance companies, and third-party suppliers.
- Ensuring all compliance and regulatory paperwork is completed correctly.
- Processing invoices and handling vehicle registration documentation.
- Supporting the sales team with administrative tasks and reporting.
- Answering telephone and email enquiries in a professional manner.
- Maintaining accurate databases and filing systems.

To be considered for the Sales Administrator role you must have:
- Previous administration experience within a busy office environment.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- The ability to prioritise workload and meet deadlines.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office packages.
- A positive, team-oriented approach and willingness to learn.

Previous motor trade experience is preferred but not essential, as full training will be provided for the right candidate.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary.
- Monday to Friday working pattern, supporting a great work-life balance.
- Full training and ongoing support.
- Opportunities for career development and progression.
- A friendly and supportive working environment.
- The chance to work within a well-established and growing motor trade business.

If you are an organised and motivated administrator looking to build or continue your career within the motor industry, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Operations Coordinator
description:
Operations Coordinator Spider is advertising on behalf of IKON Training, who are looking for a confident, highly organised and proactive Operations Coordinator to join their team in Ipswich, Suffolk.

This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday role for someone who loves bringing people, plans and priorities together. You'll combine exceptional organisation with confident communication, strong relationship-building skills and proactive problem-solving to ensure training delivery runs smoothly and efficiently.

Fantastic company benefits include:
- Salary: £30,000 £33,000 per annum
- Holiday: 23 days annual leave plus Christmas shutdown
- Hours: Flexible working hours, with availability required by 8.30am
- Working arrangements: After probation, opportunity for hybrid/ flexible working

About the role

You'll take ownership of turning agreed training commitments into efficiently scheduled, well-organised and successfully delivered courses.

Working closely with clients, trainers and internal teams, you'll build strong relationships, proactively secure training dates and make effective use of trainer availability. You'll anticipate challenges, manage competing priorities and find practical solutions, balancing excellent service with operational and commercial efficiency.

Key responsibilities include:
- Proactively securing training dates, scheduling courses and allocating trainers to make effective use of available capacity.
- Building trusted relationships with clients, trainers and colleagues, using confident communication to progress arrangements.
- Coordinating course bookings, confirmations, venues, travel and accommodation.
- Anticipating scheduling conflicts, resolving issues and managing last-minute changes
- Coordinating learner registrations, communications, attendance and certificates
- Maintaining accurate records in the training management system and supporting invoicing processes
- Identifying operational risks, escalating concerns and improving scheduling efficiency

About you

You'll have proven experience in scheduling, resource coordination or operational service delivery, with exceptional organisation, accuracy and attention to detail.

You'll be a confident communicator and natural relationship builder; you'll enjoy working with people, picking up the phone and influencing decisions. You'll know how to manage expectations, constructively challenge requests and keep arrangements moving forward.

You'll be proactive, resourceful and commercially aware, anticipating problems before they arise and finding practical solutions. You'll thrive on managing competing priorities, take ownership of your work and understand the importance of balancing excellent service with operational efficiency.

You'll love a good process, take pride in accuracy and be comfortable learning new digital systems.

Previous experience in the training industry is desirable but not essential. We're more interested in your judgement, transferable skills and ability to make things happen.

About IKON Training

For over 20 years, IKON Training has partnered with organisations across the UK to help protect their people, build lasting capability and create safer, more confident workplaces.

We specialise in practical learning that helps people prevent and manage conflict and challenging behaviour, with ongoing support that extends beyond the training session.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. You'll join a collaborative, supportive team where your contribution helps create exceptional learning experiences for our clients and learners.

To be considered, apply through Spider with an up-to-date CV.

title: Service Centre Administrator
company: Metro Supply Chain Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
About the job

At Metro Supply Chain UK, we're big enough to offer exciting opportunities and long-term stability, but small enough for every individual to make a difference.

With approximately 300 colleagues across our sites in Suffolk, Norfolk, Bedford and Wales, we've built a reputation for delivering flexible warehousing and logistics solutions while maintaining the family-business values we were founded on.

JOB SUMMARY

We are looking for a Service Centre Administrator to join our team in Saxham!

This role is the first port of call for products arriving on site, responsible for organising and processing stock.

They will be receiving stock onto the Warehouse Management System, and raising queries where needed.

Excellent communication and organisational skills are essential in this role!

There is a physical element to this role - the lifting and moving of heavy items.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Within the role, the following are the kinds of tasks and responsibilities that will be included. If you spot something that you re not able to do, or you haven t come across before, that is OK. We don t expect candidates to know how to do everything on this list.

Unload delivery vehicles, ensuring that all products are booked using the appropriate system, and any discrepancies are raised as per service agreements.

Advising the Service Centre Supervisor of any products that have been booked in requiring further attention by a senior person.

To maintain a clean working area including IT equipment, to ensure a high level of Health and Safety is present.

To provide details on progress of repairs when requested by Customer Care.

To process Return to Stock (RTS) in accordance with the correct process.

To process bulk returns in accordance with the appropriate WMS.

To book in spares upon arrival into the appropriate WMS.

To pick and pack spare parts, based on the customers SLA.

To complete reworks as required.

To liaise with Customer Care and external customer contacts to identify and resolve queries regarding products the administrator is unable to book in.

Support the Service Centre Supervisor and other members of the management team as required.

Work at a timely pace to ensure that sufficient repairs are available for the engineering workshop.

Complete manual warehouse orientated tasks, including lifting potentially heavy items, in line with the department s needs.

Learn other roles within the department and provide cover when required in line with current experience.

Work towards a FLT license, preferably Counterbalance, in line with the department s needs.

Maintain customer delivery spreadsheets.

Develop and maintain good relationships with all internal customers and colleagues to benefit co-workers, the company, and the customer.

Develop and maintain good relationships with all external customers to benefit co-workers, the company, and the customer.

Work on own initiative within the deadline set by the customers requirements.

What we are looking for:

Experience working with customers, with a high level of customer service, is very important in this role.

While warehouse experience isn t essential, we would be keen to hear from people who have experience in warehouses, or similar environments.

The role has physical elements and so the ability to lift heavy items in a repetitive manner is important.

Why Join Us:
- Work in an environment where safety is our first priority
- The opportunity to build a career with a growing company
- Company sponsored social events
- Community volunteering
- Death in Service
- Medical Cover
- BUPA Cashplan

We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building and fostering a diverse workplace where people feel included and valued. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals.

Should you require accommodation for a special ability or need during the recruitment process, please reach out to a member of our Human Resources Team

title: Executive Assistant
description:
EXECUTIVE ASSISTANT TO SLT

We are currently supporting a well-established organisation in Lowestoft with the recruitment of an experienced Executive Assistant to provide dedicated support to the senior leadership team on a maternity cover basis.
This is a fantastic opportunity for a professional, highly organised, and proactive individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment. - Provide confidential and proactive executive support to the Executive Team.
- Manage complex diaries, schedules, meetings, and travel arrangements.
- Screen, prioritise, and coordinate high volumes of communication and correspondence.
- Prepare agendas, reports, briefing notes, presentations, and professional documentation.
- Attend Executive Team and Board meetings, producing accurate minutes and action logs.
- Conduct research and analyse information to support strategic decision-making.
- Coordinate and support governance activities, ensuring actions and deadlines are met.
- Manage and respond to complex complaints, enquiries, and information requests.
- Support the delivery of key organisational projects and initiatives.
- Build effective relationships with internal teams, external stakeholders, and partner organisations.
- Assist with annual reports, business plans, and organisational documentation.
- Maintain accurate record management systems and administrative processes.

What We re Looking For:
- Previous experience supporting senior leaders, directors, or executive-level management.
- Experience preparing reports, correspondence, agendas, briefing papers, and other professional documentation.
- Proven experience taking accurate minutes in complex meetings and ensuring actions are monitored through to completion.
- Exceptional organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to build relationships across all levels.
- Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
- Excellent Microsoft Office skills, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
- The ability to work independently, use initiative, and proactively solve problems.
- Strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Experience managing complex diaries, inboxes, and administrative processes.

Desirable (but not essential):
- Project management experience.
- Experience monitoring or managing budgets.
- Experience supporting governance activities, boards, committees, or senior leadership meetings.

This 12 month fixed term contract role is on-site at their offices in Woodbridge and offers a salary of around 28,000 plus private healthcare, 25 days annual leave and the opportunity for the position to extend into a permanent opportunity.

If you're a Document Controller with construction and document management system experience (e.g., CEMAR / Asite / similar) and want to join a project team where strong document control directly supports programme delivery and compliance, submit your CV to apply today.

Responsibilities of the Document Controller

Reporting to the Office Manager, you will:
- Provide efficient administrative and accounts support to the Office Manager and wider office personnel
- Produce reports and trackers to support the document management process
- Produce and present dashboards to the management team
- Update and maintain design trackers
- Manage incoming and outgoing correspondence
- Scan, upload, convert, store, and archive documentation in line with the document management system and process
- Check and submit documents on time ahead of submission due dates
- Ensure documents are compliant with internal and client requirements (avoiding disqualification due to format or submission issues)
- Maintain accurate records in the electronic document management system
- Support and guide the project team in using the electronic data management system and document management process
- Ensure documentation, drawings, and specifications are current and at the correct revision
- Maintain filing/archiving in the correct locations, including platforms such as SharePoint, Asite, or AutoDesk (as appropriate)

Required qualifications and experience

To be considered, you must have:
- 2+ years' experience in an administrative document control role, ideally within construction, infrastructure or a site-based environment.
- Strong IT skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, email, internet)
- Experience using a document control system (e.g., Asite, AutoDesk, or similar)
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills and a professional telephone manner
- Strong organisation, time management, discretion, and confidentiality
- Full UK driving licence

Desirable experience

It would be an advantage, but is not essential, to have:
- Previous experience working Document Controller role within construction.
- Experience with scanning/uploading on CEMAR / Asite / similar DMS

Salary and benefits
- Salary: Up to 28,000
- Contract: 12 month FTC with potential to extend/go permanent
- Working pattern: 39-hour week, 5 days (Monday-Friday), on-site
- Location: Woodbridge
- Benefits: 25 days holiday + birthday off, all travel expenses paid, private healthcare, progression opportunities.

IDNUC

Astute Technical is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy.

title: HR Advisor / Coordinator
company: Select Recruitment Specialists Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
HR Coordinator / Advisor Seatrium Offshore Renewable Services (ORS)

Location: Lowestoft, Suffolk fully site-based
Salary: £30-35k negotiable dependent upon level of experience and CIPD qualification (or equivalent)
Hours: Monday Thursday 8:30am 5:30pm, Friday 8:30am 4:00pm (early finish every Friday). Part-time working can be considered initially, with scope to increase.
Contract: Permanent

The Opportunity

Select Recruitment Specialists are proud to be working in partnership with Seatrium ORS, a long-standing and valued client, to find an HR Coordinator/Advisor to join their Lowestoft team at a genuinely exciting time.

If you've followed the local news, you'll know why. Seatrium ORS has broken ground on a landmark new strategic hub at Lowestoft's PowerPark, a striking two-storey, glass-fronted building that cements the town's position as a premier UK hub for clean energy. The site already supports 50+ staff, with plans to recruit a further people as the business grows in offshore renewables.

HR has been outsourced until now but as they continue to grow, that function needs to be bought in-house and expanded upon. You will be fully supported by the HR Consultant during this transition and benefit from their knowledge of the business and HR expertise. As you, the role and the business continue to develop, you will have genuine autonomy to review, develop, and improve existing processes while building the HR function in a way that fits the business as it scales.

Part of the global Seatrium group, Seatrium ORS has been at the forefront of the offshore energy industry from its Lowestoft base since the 1960s. It delivers maintenance, repair, hook-up and commissioning solutions for the offshore wind sector. Its recent track record includes major contract wins on flagship offshore wind projects such as Hornsea 2 and Sofia, and a framework agreement with TenneT to supply HVDC systems for offshore wind projects in the Netherlands.

With a port on the doorstep, a highly skilled local workforce and major offshore wind developments close by, Lowestoft is where they plan to keep growing, and they're investing heavily in their people to make it happen.

The Role
- Being the first point of contact for day-to-day HR queries from managers and employees
- Coordinating recruitment, onboarding and offboarding, and acting as the key contact for recruitment agencies
- Maintaining HR systems, records and compliance requirements
- Supporting managers with 121s and appraisals, and helping keep completion on track across departments
- Supporting employee relations matters including absence, disciplinaries and grievances, with guidance from the HR consultant
- Helping to develop and promote the apprenticeship scheme as a key talent pipeline
- Getting involved in community and CSR projects, and representing the business at company events
- Partnering with the outsourced HR consultant on policies and processes as the function grows

This role is based full-time on site in Lowestoft. There is no working from home or hybrid option, and this is non-negotiable. This is a hands-on role at the heart of a busy operational site, working face-to-face with managers, apprentices and teams every day. If you enjoy being visible, present and in the thick of it, read on.

What You'll Need

Essential:
- CIPD Level 3 (or equiv), or working towards it, with an appetite to progress to Level 5
- Generalist HR or HR administration experience
- Strong organisation and the ability to juggle multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Confidence to build relationships with managers and employees at all levels
- Able to commute to Lowestoft daily and be on site full-time

Desirable:
- Experience in a manufacturing, engineering, offshore or industrial environment
- Exposure to apprenticeships, early careers or community projects
- Experience supporting recruitment or working with agencies

You'll Be
- Organised, proactive and eager to learn
- A confident, approachable communicator
- Comfortable using your initiative
- Keen to grow your HR career alongside a growing business

What's On Offer
- Salary of £30-35k (DOE)
- Additional benefits package
- Early Friday finish at 4pm
- A brand-new, purpose-built workplace at PowerPark
- The chance to help shape an in-house HR function from the start
- Real development and progression as the business and the HR function grow
- A front-row seat in one of East Anglia's clean energy success stories

How to Apply

Select Recruitment Specialists are a trusted recruitment partner to Seatrium ORS, and all applications will be handled by us on their behalf.

If you're an HR professional at the start of your career who wants variety, development and the chance to grow with a business that has real momentum, apply now or contact Helen Pitcher to discuss further.

title: Operations Co-ordinator
description:
Operations Co-ordinator Spider is advertising on behalf of an established freight forwarding company who are looking for an Operations Co-ordinator to join their team on the outskirts of Ipswich, Suffolk.

This is a permanent, full-time, office-based role offering the opportunity to build on your freight forwarding experience across road, air and sea freight.

Fantastic company benefits include:
- Salary:£35,000 £40,000 per annum, depending on experience
- Career development: In-house training and opportunities to progress into senior or specialist roles
- Working environment: A supportive team where knowledge and experience are shared

About the role

You'll manage your own shipments from booking through to final delivery, with a focus on European road freight. You'll also have the opportunity to develop your experience in air and sea freight, supplier negotiations and transport pricing.

Your day-to-day responsibilities will include:
- Co-ordinating road, air and sea freight shipments
- Keeping customers informed throughout the delivery process
- Working with hauliers, shipping lines and overseas partners
- Tracking shipments and resolving delays or delivery issues
- Reviewing supplier rates, sourcing new suppliers and assisting with negotiations
- Maintaining accurate shipment documentation and supplier pricing records

About you

You'll have at least two years' recent experience in freight forwarding or logistics, ideally with knowledge of European road freight. Experience in air and sea freight would be an advantage.

You'll be used to managing multiple shipments, dealing directly with customers and suppliers, and resolving transport issues as they arise.

This role would suit someone who enjoys seeing shipments through from start to finish and wants to develop their knowledge of different transport methods, pricing and supplier management.

A full UK driving licence is essential.

About the organisation

Our client is a B Corp-certified freight forwarding company that believes in doing business responsibly, building lasting relationships and investing in its people. You'll join a team that encourages you to learn, take ownership of your work and build a long-term career in logistics.

To be considered, apply through Spider with an up-to-date CV.

Spider is committed to equal opportunities and welcomes applications from suitably qualified candidates. Please advise us of any reasonable adjustments required during recruitment. Please check your inbox and spam/junk folder for correspondence.

Spider is advertising this vacancy on behalf of the employer. Your details will be processed for this vacancy, and you may be contacted by email, text or telephone. Full Privacy Policy details will be provided by email upon application.

title: Procurement Coordinator
description:
The Opportunity

We are looking for an organised, proactive Procurement Coordinator to manage the smooth progression of customer orders from supplier placement through to delivery and invoicing. You will take ownership of orders for an allocated group of clients, working closely with suppliers, customers and colleagues to deliver excellent service and meet commitments.

Key Responsibilities
- Place orders with suppliers promptly, verify acknowledgements for price, specification and delivery
- Expedite outstanding orders and proactively monitor progress to meet agreed delivery dates.
- Coordinate shipping and dispatch for your client accounts, liaising closely with the Shipping & Logistics Coordinator.
- Manage issues involving excess, incorrect, damaged or returned goods in a timely manner.
- Keep customers regularly informed of order status and take ownership of meeting their expectations and delivery commitments.
- Ensure customer invoices are accurate and submitted in accordance with relevant procedures.
- Act as a key point of contact for order communications, maintaining effective relationships between customers, suppliers and internal teams.
- Support team priorities and contribute ideas to improve processes and customer experience.

What We're Looking For
- Excellent organisation, attention to detail and the ability to prioritise a varied workload.
- Confident written and verbal communication, particularly by telephone, with customers, suppliers and colleagues.
- A customer-focused approach: understanding requirements, responding effectively and building confidence.
- Practical problem-solving skills, initiative and a willingness to take responsibility.
- Drive, maturity, flexibility, a collaborative mindset and confidence to challenge constructively.
- An interest in procurement and a commitment to learning and professional development.

Our Benefits
- Competitive salary and discretionary annual performance bonus.
- 37.5 hr. week, 20 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, increasing with length of service.
- 1 day additional annual leave - Birthday Leave
- Free on-site parking, EV Scheme & free EV Charging.
- Cycle to Work scheme.
- Private Medical Insurance
- Workplace pension scheme.
- Support with training and development, including progression towards CIPS qualifications.
- Opportunities for career growth and advancement in a friendly, collaborative team.
- Regular events and social activities.

title: Medical Receptionist
description: Join Our Team as a Medical Receptionist at High Street Surgery At High Street Surgery, we believe every patient deserves to feel listened to, cared for, and supported from the moment they contact us. Our reception team is the first friendly voice on the phone and the first welcoming smile at the front desk, making our medical receptionists an essential part of the care we provide. This role goes far beyond answering calls and booking appointments. As a medical receptionist, you will be the bridge between patients and our clinical team, helping people access the care they need, offering reassurance when they may feel anxious, and ensuring their experience with us is as smooth and positive as possible. High Street Surgery is proud to be a CQC-rated Good practice and a designated training practice, supporting the development of doctors, nurses, and other healthcare professionals. By joining our team, youll be part of a forward-thinking practice that values learning, teamwork, and continuous improvement, while keeping compassionate patient care at the centre of everything we do. If you are someone who enjoys helping others, thrives in a supportive environment, and takes pride in being organised and approachable, we would love to hear from you. Please note that it is expected that we will receive a large volume of applications for this post and may need to close this advert early. Welcoming patients in person and on the telephone, offering a kind and professional first point of contact. Booking and managing appointments using the clinical system, ensuring patients are directed to the most appropriate clinician or service. Handling patient queries with empathy and confidentiality, signposting to healthcare professionals or external services when needed. Supporting clinicians by preparing notes, updating patient records, and ensuring the smooth flow of information within the practice. Managing correspondence, including emails, letters, and test results, ensuring these are processed and filed correctly. Assisting with the registration of new patients, updating records, and maintaining accurate patient information. Ensuring confidentiality and data protection are upheld at all times when dealing with sensitive patient information. Supporting the wider practice team, contributing to a friendly, efficient, and caring environment for both patients and staff. Undertaking general administrative tasks such as scanning, filing, photocopying, and maintaining reception areas to a high standard *** Please note that this role is a full time position, successful applicants will need to be available to work between the hours of 7.45am & 6.30pm*** Any other duties as required that the practice may deem appropraite.
